settingsScreen.text12: Haikwanisi kurodha zvaunofarira. Vhura Settings zvakare.
settingsScreen.text13: Muedzo unotora masekonzi matatu. Inogadzirisawo huwandu hwefoni. Kubata uku kunoshandiswa nechishandiso chakavhurika; kunze kwayo, shandisa zviziviso zvekufona pazasi.
settingsScreen.text15: Inogamuchira chiziviso kunze kweKOSOLOLA. Tinya chenjedzo kuti uvhure app wopindura uku kufona kuri kurira.
settingsScreen.text18: Zviziviso zvakavharwa. Bvumira zviziviso kubva kuKOSOLOLA mufoni yako kana browser zvigadziriso uye tinya Edza zvakare.
settingsScreen.text26: Yambiro yekuremekedza Usakanganisa maitiro uye mvumo yefoni. Ivo vanoda internet uye havatsivire kurira kwekufona kwemuno.
settingsScreen.text27: Yambiro sevhisi haipo. Tokonya Edza zvakare.
settingsScreen.text40: Kuvhara kupinda kunodzivirira kuvandudzwa kwechikamu ichocho. Chiziviso chakatopihwa chinogona kuramba chiripo kusvika chapera.
settingsScreen.text41: Hatikwanise kubvunza masesesheni. Simbisa kubatana uye edza zvakare.
settingsScreen.text45: MVP: Mameseji uye mafoni anoshandisa iyo Yamilook sevhisi. Kunze-kwe-app chenjedzo kunoda kuti ishandiswe pachigadzirwa ichi. End-to-end encryption haisati yaitwa.
settingsScreen.text46: Kupinda kunongobuda iyi KOSOLOLA yekuisa. Nhaurirano dzinochengetwa muakaundi yako.
settingsScreen.text47: PaiPhone kana iPad, shandisa Goverana → Wedzera kuHome Screen uye vhura iyo KOSOLOLA neikoni kuti umutse zviziviso.
settingsScreen.text48: Inovhura iyo KOSOLOLA pamusoro peHTTPS yekubatanidza kuti igone kuzivisa.
settingsScreen.text49: Inogadziridza iPhone kana iPad kuiOS 16.4 kana gare gare uye inovhura KOSOLOLA kubva pachiratidzo chiri pachiratidziro chikuru.
settingsScreen.text50: Iyi bhurawuza haitsigire chenjedzo dzekufona. Inoshandisa browser yakagadziridzwa ine tsigiro yekuzivisa.
settingsScreen.text51: Haikwanise kubata iyo yambiro sevhisi. Edza zvakare.
settingsScreen.text53: Bvumira zviziviso mumaseting emudziyo kuti ugamuchire chenjedzo.
settingsScreen.text55: Kutarisa zviziviso kwakatora nguva yakareba. Inotarisa kubatana uye inodzvanya Edza zvakare.
